title: Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Project-Size Pricing Tier
content:
**Pricing tier schedule.** The size of the financed project sets a pricing tier for a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account whose plan carries no promotion, fixed when the loan was made, read from the signed contract price of the window or door contract the account funds: a contract price at or above the large-project price of 45000.00 takes the large-project rate cut of 0.25% off; a contract price below the small-project price of 15000.00 adds the small-project rate addition of 0.25%; any other contract price leaves the rate.

The contract price is the signed contract price on the Window Replacement Contracts contract, or the Entry & Patio Door Contracts contract, that the account funds. The tier adjusts the purchase APR in arriving at the annual rate of monthly interest.

| Signed contract price of the financed contract | Pricing tier |
|---|---|
| 45000.00 or more | Less 0.25% |
| 15000.00 or more, below 45000.00 | No change |
| Below 15000.00 | Plus 0.25% |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical contract prices)

| Contract price | Tier |
|---|---|
| 45000.00 | Less 0.25% |
| 44999.99 | No change |
| 15000.00 | No change |
| 14999.99 | Plus 0.25% |
